# Andres Felipe Pisso — Game UX/UI Designer & UX Lead

> Portfolio site for Andres Felipe Pisso (@byandresfe), a Game UX/UI Designer and UX Lead
> based in Bogotá, Colombia. Specialises in game interfaces, UI systems, player experience
> design, feedback clarity, and cross-functional UX leadership. 11+ years across games,
> VR, UEFN / Fortnite Creative, LiveOps, and digital products.

## Expertise

Game UX/UI Design, UX Leadership, UI Systems, HUD Design, Player Experience Design,
Feedback Systems, Player Decision-Making, LiveOps UX, UEFN / Fortnite Creative,
VR Interface Design (Meta Quest), Accessibility in Games, Design Documentation,
Design Systems, Figma, Unreal Engine, Cross-functional Collaboration

## Work (Case Files)

Full case list at: https://byandresfe.com/work

### CASE-008 — Star Wars Roguelike One
URL: https://byandresfe.com/case/star-wars-roguelike-one
Role: UX/UI Designer
Year: 2026
Focus: Game UX/UI for a Star Wars roguelike experience.

### CASE-001 — Orcs Must Die: By the Blade
URL: https://byandresfe.com/case/orcs-must-die-by-the-blade
Role: UX Lead
Studio: Robot Entertainment
Platform: Meta Quest VR
Year: 2025–2026
Status: Shipped (NDA-safe)
Focus: UI design system, reusable assets, VR interaction patterns, UX leadership, design documentation. Created a unified Figma design system covering components, states, tokens, and variables. Designed VR-specific UI including a diegetic guide book, contextual interaction language, and haptic-reinforced feedback. Led a team of 3 UX/UI designers.

### CASE-002 — D&D: Zombie Dragon Adventure (Fortnite)
URL: https://byandresfe.com/case/zombie-dragon-adventure
Role: UX Lead
Platform: UEFN / Fortnite Creative
Year: 2025
Status: Active (shipped)
Focus: UX/UI systems for a D&D roguelike adventure inside Fortnite. Designed the Adventure Menu (player progression hub), FTUX onboarding structure, store flows, camp upgrade system, and implementation-ready documentation. Led a team of 3 designers over a 4-month production window.

### CASE-003 — The Walking Dead: Courtyard King
URL: https://byandresfe.com/case/courtyard-king
Role: UX/UI Designer
Platform: UEFN / Fortnite Creative
Year: 2025
Status: NDA-safe
Focus: Survival UX, tension-preserving HUD design, threat communication, resource legibility, and cooperative feedback systems for a Walking Dead Universe experience inside Fortnite.

### CASE-004 — Raptor Heist
URL: https://byandresfe.com/case/raptor-heist
Role: UX/UI Designer
Platform: UEFN / Fortnite Creative
Year: 2025
Focus: Roguelike UX clarity, player feedback, UI systems for a Havoc Hotel roguelike experience in UEFN.

### CASE-005 — Havoc Hotel 3
URL: https://byandresfe.com/case/havoc-hotel-3

### CASE-006 — Zomvilles

## En español / Spanish summary

Andres Felipe Pisso es un Diseñador UX/UI de Videojuegos y Líder de UX basado en Bogotá, Colombia.
Especializado en interfaces de juego, sistemas de UI, diseño de HUD, experiencia del jugador,
claridad de retroalimentación, accesibilidad en videojuegos, UEFN / Fortnite Creative,
interfaces VR (Meta Quest) y liderazgo de diseño UX. Más de 11 años de experiencia.

Disponible para proyectos freelance, contratos remotos, consultoría y oportunidades seleccionadas
en diseño UX/UI de videojuegos, producto digital y sistemas de diseño.
Contacto: https://byandresfe.com/#contact — LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/afpisso
